---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new idea or improvement for Elite Tech Shop
title: Feature Request
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
type: Feature

---

## ✨ Feature Description
Clearly describe the feature you’d like to see added.  
Example: "Add dark mode toggle to the settings page."

---

## 🎯 Problem Statement
Explain what problem this feature solves or why it matters.  
Example: "Users struggle with eye strain when using the app at night."

---

## 🛠 Proposed Solution
Describe how you’d like the feature to work.  
Example: "Add a toggle in the navbar that switches the theme to dark mode."

---

## 📎 Alternatives Considered
List any other approaches you thought about.  
Example: "Could also auto‑detect system theme, but manual toggle gives more control."

---

## ✅ Acceptance Criteria
- Feature aligns with project scope
- Doesn’t break existing functionality
- Realistic for implementation in upcoming release cycle

---

## 🎉 Additional Context
Add screenshots, mockups, or references if available.
